name: taskflow-pro
description: Desktop task management application built with React, Vite, and Electron

scripts.sign:dev: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { try { require('child_process').execSync('codesign --force --deep --sign - node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app'); console.log('[sign:dev] Ad-hoc signed Electron.app for macOS notifications'); } catch(e){ console.warn('[sign:dev] Could not sign Electron.app:', e.message); } }"
